purpose: Teach: 気功/狂牛病/磁場/下水道/社会保険庁/地表/脱臼/精油

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員ヨガに気功も取り入れろ
lines.en: I want us to incorporate qigong into our staff yoga program.
lines.style: Authoritative, clipped delivery. Commands stated as fact, not question. Breath behind each phrase. Expectation of compliance, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。狂牛病リスク管理を食品事業で強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen mad cow disease risk management across the food division.
lines.style: Formal acknowledgment. Measured cadence, each clause distinct. Slight nod in the voice—competent and ready to execute. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、磁場関連機器の研究開発を進めろ
lines.en: I want us to accelerate our R&D on magnetic field equipment.
lines.style: Stated with quiet confidence. Emphasis lands on 'accelerate.' Unhurried but final. The tone of someone used to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の下水道排水基準を厳守します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure strict compliance with wastewater discharge standards at the facility.
lines.style: Professional, steady. Each element of the plan articulated with clear precision. Competent reassurance—this will be handled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社会保険庁手続きを社内で支援しろ
lines.en: Make sure we're supporting staff with social insurance procedures in-house.
lines.style: Brief, purposeful. Slight weight on 'supporting'—it matters. No elaboration needed. The certainty of someone delegating to a trusted hand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地表温度測定機器の販売も検討します
lines.en: Understood. We'll also explore selling surface temperature measurement equipment.
lines.style: Even tone, methodical. Each item on the list given equal weight. Shows preparation—this is already anticipated. Calm efficiency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員のスポーツ脱臼対策にも保険を整えろ
lines.en: Set up insurance coverage for sports-related joint dislocation injuries among staff.
lines.style: Concrete and final. Emphasis on the protective measure itself. Low, steady volume. No request for feedback—this is settled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。精油商品の品質を向上します
lines.en: Understood. We'll improve the quality standards on our essential oil product line.
lines.style: Closing statement with finality. Calm, assured. Slight lightening at the end—the meeting is winding down. Professional but not stiff.
